articles.title: India's Digital Public Infrastructure Model Adopted as ITU Global Standard
articles.summary: The International Telecommunication Union (ITU) has officially adopted India's modular Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) framework as a global benchmark for digital inclusion.
prelims: Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) comprises identity (Aadhaar), real-time payments (UPI), and open data-sharing layers (DigiLocker).
The International Telecommunication Union (ITU) is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for global information and communication technologies.
The framework emphasizes open APIs, interoperability, vendor neutrality, and non-proprietary standards.
articles.mains: Examine how India's Digital Public Infrastructure acts as an effective instrument of soft power diplomacy and aids global South nations in achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

articles.title: Operationalization of India's Domestic Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS)
articles.summary: The Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) notifies compliance targets and trading mechanisms for energy-intensive sectors under the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme.
prelims: CCTS was established under the provisions of the Energy Conservation Act, 2001 (amended in 2022).
The Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) serves as the administrator, while the Grid Controller of India functions as the registry.
The market covers both a mandatory compliance sector for obligated entities and a voluntary offset market for non-obligated entities.
articles.mains: Discuss the potential of market-based instruments like the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) in helping India achieve its Panchamrit targets and Net-Zero commitment by 2070.

articles.title: NISAR Mission Delivers High-Resolution Global Biomass and Earth Deformation Map
articles.summary: The joint ISRO-NASA NISAR satellite mission releases its first comprehensive dual-frequency radar dataset tracking global forest carbon stocks and land movement.
prelims: NISAR carries both L-band (developed by NASA) and S-band (developed by ISRO) Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) systems.
It is the first satellite radar mission to systematically map Earth using two different radar frequencies.
The mission maps the entire land surface every 12 days to monitor glacier movement, crustal deformation, groundwater changes, and biomass dynamics.
articles.mains: Analyze the significance of remote sensing and Earth observation satellites in disaster management and climate change mitigation, with special reference to NISAR.

articles.title: Strategic Integration of Chabahar Port into the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC)
articles.summary: India and Central Asian nations sign a multilateral agreement integrating the Shahid Beheshti Terminal at Chabahar directly into the main INSTC operational framework.
prelims: INSTC is a 7,200-km multi-modal transport route connecting India, Iran, Azerbaijan, Russia, and Europe.
Shahid Beheshti Port at Chabahar provides India direct sea-land access to Central Asia and Afghanistan bypassing Pakistan.
The agreement introduces unified digital transit customs declarations and standardized container logistics protocols across member countries.
articles.mains: Assess the geo-economic and geopolitical significance of the INSTC and Chabahar Port for India's strategic outreach to Central Asia and Eurasia.

articles.title: Union Cabinet Approves National Clean Coastal Ecosystem Mission (NCCEM)
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approves a major ecological initiative aimed at combating ocean plastic pollution, restoring blue carbon sinks, and securing coastal community livelihoods.
prelims: NCCEM focuses on Integrated Coastal Zone Management (ICZM) covering India's 7,516 km coastline.
The mission targets the restoration of key 'Blue Carbon' ecosystems including mangroves, seagrass meadows, and coral reefs.
It aligns with UN Sustainable Development Goal 14 (Life Below Water) and the global 30x30 target under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
articles.mains: Critically evaluate the vulnerability of India's coastal ecosystems to climate change and discuss the role of community-led restoration projects in coastal hazard mitigation.
